HIMA Group is a globally independent provider of safety-related automation solutions for the process and rail industries, protecting people, assets, and the environment. Today, HIMA employs approximately 1,100 professionals across 22 group companies worldwide.

Our international teams bring together expertise from all corners of the world, working with a shared focus on developing reliable and sustainable solutions. At HIMA, employees are encouraged to take initiative, contribute their knowledge, and collaborate across borders to deliver projects with real impact.

Working at HIMA offers varied and responsible tasks, where your work has tangible influence. At the same time, you can continuously develop your skills and contribute to advancing safety technology. With a corporate culture built on collaboration, accountability, and sustainable innovation, we provide a professional environment where experts can thrive and make meaningful contributions.

Become part of a global success story and help shape the future of digital safety.

 Responsibilities

- Disciplinary leadership and continuous development of the Mechatronics team

- Collaboration with adjacent departments such as Production, Production Engineering, and Procurement to ensure manufacturable product development
- Evaluation and assurance of the manufacturability of mechatronic components, including the selection and application of appropriate manufacturing methods while considering commercial constraints
- Consideration of and technical responsibility for surface treatment and coating technologies within product development
- Advising internal stakeholders on all aspects of mechatronics development
- Planning, conceptualization, and execution of development projects—from requirements analysis through to series production readiness
- Resource and capacity planning for development projects
- Responsibility for the Mechatronics Development Laboratory

Requirements

- Degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- Strong knowledge of mechatronic system development, including relevant standards and regulations
- Experience in the structuring and integration of assemblies consisting of mechanical, electronic, and software components
- Experience with manufacturability analysis and Design for Manufacturing (DfM)
- Knowledge of common coating and surface treatment processes and their impact on component properties
- Practical experience in cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Production and Manufacturing Engineering
- Strong quality and safety awareness
- Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken
- Experience with modern development and simulation tools (e.g., CAD, FEM, thermal simulation, Teamcenter) is desirable
- Proven leadership experience with responsibility for building, developing, and motivating high-performing engineering teams

Our Benefits

- Purpose-driven work: Contribute to sustainable solutions in safety-related automation that protect people, assets, and the environment.
- Global collaboration and diversity: Work in diverse, internationally aligned teams that act as “One Team, One Goal” to deliver results worldwide.
- Knowledge-driven culture: Share ideas, think entrepreneurially, and contribute to innovative solutions with tangible impact.

jobs.description:
Apply Now
Area Product Owner (f/m/d) for the Industry Knowledge Graphs

Date: 06/22/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Summary & Role Information:

At SAP Business AI, we are exploring the next frontier of AI on structured business data like graphs, tables and more. Foundation Models on structured data, like SAP-RPT-1, have ushered in the GenAI era for business relevant scenarios. Now, we are pushing further. We want to enable companies across all industries to collaboratively train foundation models and build knowledge graphs.

As Area Product Owner (f/m/d) you will own the product backlog for the Industry Knowledge Graphs (IKGs) – the unified, semantically rich representation of domain specific and generalized business entities, processes, and relationships across SAP applications and industries. You translate strategy and stakeholder needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap, write the user stories that drive delivery, and partner closely with the IKG Tech Lead, knowledge engineers, data engineers and AI scientists to ship. You also represent the IKGs to its consumers – the MMIFM teams developing multi-modal industry foundation models and OP4I and an open data platformteams, SAP product groups including SAP Knowledge Graph, and external partners – making sure what we build matches what they need. You work alongside architects, designers, engineers and senior product managers to refine value proposition and execution. You will help shape concept documents and (sub-)proposals for new IKGs capabilities, and ensure alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders including senior management in a complex, dynamic environment.

What You'll do:

- 
Own and prioritize the IKGs product backlog – gather requirements, write user stories, and ensure the team is always working on the highest-value items

- 
Detail out, test and iterate the IKGs value proposition: a unifieddomain specific, trustworthy representation of SAP’s broad industry business knowledge that grounds GenAI applications and powers downstream foundation-model workstreams – for the benefit of SAP’s customers and SAP itselfthe whole European industry ecosystem

- 
Identify and onboard the IKG’s key consumers (MMIFM, OP4I, SAP product teams, external partners) and ensure tight alignment between what they need and what we ship

- 
Partner with Product Management to define the business plan and measurable outcomes for the IKGs area

- 
Work hand-in-hand with the IKGs Tech Lead and the R&D team to translate roadmap into requirements, sprint goals, and measurable releases

What you bring:

- 
8+ years of related professional experience incl. 5+ years of product ownership in the area of AI, data, or platform products

- 
Solid technical literacy in Knowledge Graphs and semantic data – you don’t need to design ontologies yourself, but you can reason about RDF, SPARQL, KG construction trade-offs, and graph RAG / LLM grounding well enough to write meaningful stories and run informed reviews with the IKG Tech Lead

- 
Passionate about identifying new ways to generate value from structured business knowledge

- 
Track record of delivering high-quality features that meet novel customer needs and balancing the needs of multiple consumers in a highly dynamic environment

- 
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box – roll up your sleeves to ship

- 
Strong abilities to manage internal stakeholders, surface use cases, and drive consensus across engineering, product, and partner organizations

- 
Exceptional teamwork abilities, including a track record of delivering C-level grade presentations and driving alignment with senior management

- 
Demonstrated capability in shaping product vision and roadmaps, running discovery, calculating business value, and making impactful product decisions on behalf of users

- 
Familiarity with SAP business applications (ERP, CRM) and their data models is a strong plus – you understand what kinds of business questions the IKG needs to answer

- 
Strong communication skills in English language – verbal and written

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Working with cross-functional teams, you'll provide technical leadership in HPLC customer engagements, conduct product demonstrations, and serve as a trusted advisor to help customers optimize their chromatography workflows and achieve their research and development goals. Education

Experience

- Minimum 5 years of technical sales experience in scientific instrumentation, laboratory products, or the life sciences industry
- Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales targets
- Experience delivering technical demonstrations and customer training
- Experience utilizing CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite
- Proven ability to manage projects and priorities within a dynamic commercial environment

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Deep technical knowledge of HPLC systems, applications, and related product portfolio
- Strong understanding of laboratory workflows and customer requirements
- Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills
- Ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
- Strong analytical thinking and strategic planning capabilities
- Proficiency in German is mandatory; proficiency in English is required

Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.

Your journey begins at our established logistics center in Wohlen, Switzerland (2-3 days per week), where you will get to know our processes, culture, and team while contributing to the cross-site project for the new location from day one. Through targeted training, workshops, and close collaboration with experienced colleagues, you will gain the insights and support needed to successfully transition into your role.

This way you experience a fully functioning operation firsthand and actively shape the future in Neuenburg at the same time. During the ramp-up phase, you act as a pragmatic all-rounder: You tackle problems wherever they arise and resolve operational bottlenecks immediately – whether at your desk or on the shop floor.

- You assess new ideas together with relevant stakeholders, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis

Diversity is our culture.

To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

Principal Clinical Research Associate (PCRA) / Klinischer Monitor – Full-Time or Part-Time Available (m/w/d)

Job available in 13 locations: Dresden, Bremen, Leipzig, Aachen, Düsseldorf, Bonn, Hamburg, Ulm, Stuttgart, Remote, Munich, Frankfurt, Berlin

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas
- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities
- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams
- Clear development pathways (e.g. Lead CRA, CTM)
- Flexible working models that support work-life balance
- Permanent employment
- Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (32 hours/week) options available

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to lead and coordinate all aspects of clinical monitoring and site management for complex clinical trials. Acting as a subject-matter expert and site process specialist, you will ensure trials are conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs—ensuring subject safety, data integrity, and continuous audit readiness.

In this principal-level role, you will manage complex and high-risk studies across multiple sponsor and monitoring models (e.g. FSO, FSP, government-sponsored research). You will serve as a key escalation point for sites and project teams, take a leadership role on assigned studies, and actively contribute to the mentoring and development of junior and senior CRAs alike.

What You’ll Do

Principal-Level Clinical Monitoring & Oversight

- Lead monitoring activities for complex, high-risk, or strategically important clinical trials using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Independently conduct on-site and remote monitoring visits in line with approved monitoring plans
- Perform and oversee SDR, SDV, and CRF review, ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and integrity
- Evaluate investigational product accountability through physical inventory and records review
- Ensure essential documents are complete, inspection-ready, and compliant with ICH-GCP and applicable German/EU regulations
- Lead site initiation, maintenance, and close-out activities, providing expert guidance and recommendations

Quality, Risk & Issue Management

- Apply advanced root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking, and problem-solving methodologies to identify systemic site issues
- Strategic Project & Stakeholder Collaboration
- Serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, sponsors, and internal project teams
- Identify trends across sites and studies and provide strategic recommendations to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Ensure accurate and timely updates of study systems (e.g. CTMS) and perform QC reviews where required
- Participate in investigator meetings and support investigator identification and feasibility activities
- Support investigator payment processes and trial financial oversight as applicable

Leadership, Mentorship & Process Improvement

- Actively mentor, coach, and support the development of junior and senior CRAs
- Contribute to project-specific and functional training initiatives
- Identify opportunities for process optimization and drive implementation of improvements
- Provide expert input into monitoring strategies and clinical operations best practices

Administrative & Operational Responsibilities

- Maintain timely and accurate completion of timesheets, expense reports, and required documentation
- Maintain frequent communication with sites between visits to ensure ongoing compliance and issue resolution
- - Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to resolution and proactively mitigate risk
- Author high-quality monitoring reports and follow-up correspondence in a timely manner
- Act as a key escalation point for significant site issues, protocol deviations, and compliance risks
- Support and lead activities related to audits, inspections, and regulatory inquiries

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in Germany

We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.
Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the Glassomer technology with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners.
A particular focus will be placed on the development of photocurable and thermoplastic silica nanocomposites, optimization of their processing behavior, and tailoring of the glass composition to improve thermal stability during fiber fabrication. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.
Developing novel photocurable silica nanocomposites for high-resolution additive manufacturing of microstructured glass preforms.
Formulating highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass processing.
Investigating particle dispersion, rheological properties, curing behavior, and processing windows of nanocomposite systems.
Processing nanocomposites using advanced manufacturing technologies, including: Stereolithography-based 3D printing, Extrusion-based shaping
Developing strategies for modifying glass compositions (e.g., dopant integration) to tailor processing and material properties.
Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.
Collaborating with project partners on the fabrication of next-generation microstructured optical fibers.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

Profound knowledge of polymer chemistry, material science and processing is required

jobs.description:
html Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) Aerospace CompositesTaufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) Aerospace Composites
Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Your mission is to lead and manage the full life-cycle of our internal COPV product development projects, ensuring technical excellence and efficient execution from concept to serial production.

- Own Internal Project Management: You are responsible for the entire project management of our new COPVs from initial component design and tool concept through prototype and series production, and additionally, open to managing other projects within the company.
- Develop Technical Solutions: You evaluate new product ideas from a technical perspective, assist the team with developing robust production concepts, and calculating internal manufacturing costs.
- Coordinate Execution: You manage all project activities, resources, and timelines, ensuring all technical and operational project goals are achieved successfully.
- Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will work closely with our core internal teams: Part Design & FEM, Toolmaking, Materials & Processes, Production, and Quality Management.
- Documentation & Standards: You ensure comprehensive project documentation and adherence to internal standards and quality requirements throughout the development process.
- Internal Stakeholder Management: You act as the central point of contact, providing clear communication and aligning expectations across all internal departments involved in product development.

YOUR PROFILE

- Manufacturing and Material Expertise: You are a proactive, solution-oriented project manager with deep expertise in advanced materials and manufacturing processes.
- Educational Background: A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a similar technical field is essential.
- Technical Expertise: You are quickly able to understand difficult technical problems and can challenge your project team on their decisions. You can guide the team to making sensible technical decisions and are comfortable with making technical decisions if needed.
- Professional Experience: You bring several years of experience in product development and technical project management, ideally within the aerospace or high-tech manufacturing sectors.
- Language Skills: Proficiency in English is needed to communicate effortlessly and precisely within the team; German is also nice to have.
- Mindset & Skills: We look for someone who is quick on the uptake, possesses strong analytical skills, and demonstrates a practical, solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges. A high level of ownership for your tasks is a must.
- Communication & Drive: Strong communication and organizational skills, coupled with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, will complete your profile.
- Composites Expertise: Possessing in-depth knowledge of fiber composite materials and their associated manufacturing processes (e.g., winding, RTM, pressing, laminating) is nice to have.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.
- Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.
- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).
- Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.
- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.
- Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.
- Unique working atmosphere: Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!

Please send your CV in English including reference number YF-50427 and get ready for take off.
